newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan budget debate stalled by opposition boycott.
newsitem.headline: Japan budget debate stalled by opposition boycott.

text.p: A key budget committee in the Lower House of Japan's parliament was unable to resume debate on Wednesday due to a boycott by the three main opposition parties.

The committee had been scheduled to convene from 9 a.m. (2400 GMT), but was unable to do so due to the absence of members of the three parties -- Shinshinto (New Frontier Party), the Democratic Party and the Taiyo (Sun) Party.

The parties are boycotting the proceedings as the ruling Liberal Democratic Party has refused to accept their demands for revisions to an extra budget for the current fiscal year, ending on March 31, opposition sources said.
The committee had been expected to vote on the supplementary budget on Wednesday.
